setup_logging: setup logging to write to stdout or a file for the master process only
log_json_stats: log training stats as JSON with optional TensorBoard writer and epoch result file output
load_json_stats: load and parse JSON stats lines from a training log file into a list of dicts
parse_json_stats: parse loaded log stats to extract values for a specific row type and key
get_log_files: get all log files and their names from a directory of trained model subdirectories
